name: All Metal Hotend Kit
description: The Micro Swiss All Metal Hotend Kit is one of the most popular all-metal upgrades for Creality Ender 3, CR-10, and other machines using the stock MK8-style hotend. It replaces the PTFE-lined thermal barrier with a full all-metal heatbreak, allowing sustained printing at higher temperatures for engineering filaments. The kit is designed as a drop-in replacement requiring no additional machining or adapter parts.
features: Drop-in replacement for stock Creality MK8 PTFE-lined hotend
All-metal heatbreak enables sustained high-temperature printing
Compatible with ABS, ASA, nylon, and other engineering filaments
Includes plated copper heat block for improved thermal performance
